aboutTimeline.title: 2 Weeks Premature & Started coming out in the Lift
aboutTimeline.desc: Steve entered the world 2 weeks early in an elevator lift at Leicester Royal Infirmary on Friday the 13th—setting the tone for a resilient life.

aboutTimeline.title: The Official 34-Year Tech Career
aboutTimeline.desc: Began programming and hardware systems engineering at 17, building foundational IT network protocols and software systems.  Started Higher National Diploma at Wigston College in Leicester.

aboutTimeline.title: Gap Year Volunteering at The Briars Residential Centre
aboutTimeline.desc:
Spending a gap year as part of the volunteer mission team at The Briars Catholic Retreat Centre in Crich, Derbyshire, is a unique and transformative experience. 

We lived in community with other young adults, develop practical and transferable skills, and serve young people from across the diocese through residential retreats filled with team-building, teaching, prayer, and fun. 

It definitely was a life changing experience for me if I’m honest, forming lifelong friendships, deepening their faith, and gaining opportunities that I never expected — making it a gap year like no other for anyone considering youth ministry or simply wanting a year of purposeful service.

aboutTimeline.title: 5 Years in Dubai (UAE)
aboutTimeline.desc: Lived and worked in Dubai for 5 years, started off at The One - Total Home Experience (https://TheOne.com) then finally ended up running the IT Systems for  News Group International and Mediawatch Dubai now called Carma.

aboutTimeline.title: Gatwick Crisis & Phoenix Tattoo
aboutTimeline.desc: Returning home from Dubai, to be honest he wasnt very at all and Steve suffered cardiac arrest on the plane as it landed at Gatwick Airport.  A couple of weeks later contracting MRSA and Pneumonia, medical teams gave near-zero odds of survival. Defying all predictions, Steve survived—commemorating his rebirth with his iconic Phoenix Tattoo on his chest.

aboutTimeline.title: Sobriety & Founding KEEP ME SOBER TOO (KMST)
aboutTimeline.desc: Sober since 2013 (13 years of continuous recovery). Steve founded KEEP ME SOBER TOO (KMST) to support individuals struggling with addiction and help their families navigate recovery.

aboutTimeline.title: Actor & Enterprise IT Architect
aboutTimeline.desc: Combining 34 years of tech expertise with professional screen acting in major commercials (Snickers with Saka & Modrić) and TV productions (Ted Lasso, The Witcher, BBC Doctors).

itTimeline.title: Opened First IT Retail Store
itTimeline.desc: NEW IT Store in Oadby, Leicester UK - provided a retail outlet for generel customers to come in and buy Newly built PC's with custo specs.  Business customers such as the British Red Cross where he provided HiTech systems which were all built with Touch Screens, new back then.  Also provided PC Systems for The Rugby World Cup 2000 Interactive Tour Bus, where Steve installed PC Systems with complete off-line websites of all the Rugby Teams in the World Cup at that time.

itTimeline.title: Started Tech & Systems Engineering
itTimeline.desc: Began programming and hardware engineering at age 17, building foundational network protocols and software systems.

itTimeline.title: 5 Years in Dubai (UAE) - Enterprise Architect
itTimeline.desc: Lived and worked in Dubai for 5 years. Engineered mission-critical media broadcasting, real-time news aggregation, and high-availability server clusters across the Middle East.

itTimeline.title: Global Cloud & Infrastructure Architect
itTimeline.desc: Architected multi-region cloud backends, microservices, load balancing, and real-time event infrastructure for global brand campaigns.

itTimeline.title: Senior Cloud Solutions & AI Architect
itTimeline.desc: 34 years of total IT industry expertise. Specializing in cloud scalability, cybersecurity, enterprise DevOps, and AI-assisted cloud migrations.

seo.title: Steve Pereira | British Indian Actor | IT Expert Since 1992 | Cardiac Arrest Survivor | Sober Since 2013
seo.description: The Official Website for Steve Pereira, a Professional  British Indian Actor from Leicester a Multi-Cultural City in the Heart of England, The Midlands.   Steve grew up and spent most of his early life in Leicester where he first started his acting career at the Haymarket Theatre at the age of 11.   Steve became a bit of an IT Nerd but got the chance to return to acting with his own unique story of survival.

siteTexts.heroSubtitle: Screen Actor, Executive Producer & Cybersecurity Founder
siteTexts.heroBio: Versatile British-Indian screen actor with an athletic build and commanding screen presence. Featured in global commercial campaigns including a Snickers with Bukayo Saka & Luka Modrić, Apple TV+'s Ted Lasso, Netflix's The Witcher, and BBC Doctors. Certified in ESPCA Stage Combat and Tactical Firearms, Steve pairs rigorous dramatic training from various Schools of Acting across the UK. Additionally Steve has a 34-year background as an enterprise IT & cybersecurity architect.
siteTexts.headshotsTitle: Professional Headshots & Full Body Standing Slates

siteTexts.actorSummary: Versatile British-Indian screen actor with an athletic build and commanding screen presence. Featured in global commercial campaigns including a Snickers with Bukayo Saka & Luka Modrić, Apple TV+'s Ted Lasso, Netflix's The Witcher, and BBC Doctors. Certified in ESPCA Stage Combat and Tactical Firearms, Steve pairs rigorous dramatic training from various Schools of Acting across the UK. Additionally Steve has a 34-year background as an enterprise IT & cybersecurity architect.
siteTexts.itSummary: Steve Pereira began his career in tech at age 17 in 1992. Now 51 in 2026, he brings over 34 years of battle-tested enterprise architecture expertise, including 5 years living and working in Dubai (UAE) engineering systems for News Group International & Mediawatch Dubai.
